newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's GOCTIC mandates US$50 mln FRN issue.
newsitem.headline: China's GOCTIC mandates US$50 mln FRN issue.

text.p: BZW Asia is forming an arranger group for Guangdong Overseas Chinese Trust and Investment Corp's (GOCTIC) US$50 million floating rate note issue, bankers said.
They said the facility has three tranches.
The US$20 million tranche A has a final maturity of three years. It pays an interest margin of 120 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
The US$15 million tranche B has a final maturity of four years and pays an interest margin of 130 basis points.
The remaining US$15 million tranche C has a final maturity of five years and pays an interest margin of 140 basis points.
Fees are 80 basis points for all tranches.
BZW Asia is the mandated arranger.
Banks are now invited to join as arrangers. They must participate in all three tranches on a pro-rata basis.
General syndication will start in early December.
